Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded option C by overemphasizing the tiny mass of an added electron and dismissing the immediate, defining effect: gaining an electron makes the atom an anion (negatively charged). Atomic mass number doesn’t change, electron mass is negligible in standard chemistry contexts, and environmental charge compensation is irrelevant to the atom’s intrinsic charge after gaining an electron. The correct choice is D.
